ios.desc:
TwoTickets: Shared Experiences, Real Connections.
=====================================

Want to meet new people in real life who share your passions? TwoTickets connects you with companions for concerts, sports games, theater shows, festivals, and other local experiences. Match over shared activities and make unforgettable memories together—whether you’re sparking a romantic connection or making new friends, Your next connection is just an Twoot away.

HOW TwoTickets WORKS
===================

Enjoy memorable experiences. It is better together.

1. Your event feed reflects your preferences
2. Pick an event that you love. The Warriors game ? Niners ? Hamilton ? With thousands of local events to choose from, fun is never in short supply
3. Twoot it. Yes, that's right. "A Twoot says “I would love to watch Taylor Swift at Levis stadium next weekend. Looking for a fellow Swiftie to enjoy it with.
3. Voila!! Your matches now comprise all the Swifties that have Twooted the event. (filtered by your preferences)
4. Like, Chat and Decide who your plus-one should be
5. GO have a blast. No awkwardness, no stress, no pressure to be “perfect”. Just be you, enjoying doing what YOU LIKE DOING with someone who likes it just as much.

WHAT IT IS NOT
============

1. Don’t expect profiles to arbitrarily appear. TWOOTING leads to Matches.
2. No bots. No fake profiles.

TwoTickets is neither a Dating app nor is it an EventBrite. It is simply a place where you can make new connections over shared recreational interests. Where those connections take you, that’s up to you.

KEY FEATURES OF TwoTickets
========================

[Event-Based Matches]: Forget endless profile swipes! Discover real events happening around you and match with people who are as excited to attend as you are. Make plans IRL and experience the event together.
Twoot Your Interest: Signal that you're ready to share the experience, and connect with a companion who’s eager to join.
[The Perfect Icebreaker]: Meeting in real life can be intimidating, TwoTickets makes it easy and fun. Your matches love the Warriors just as much as you do. How’s that for an icebreaker?
[Safety First, Always]: Trust, Authenticity, Community. These are our values. We take trust seriously. TwoTickets uses smart safety features and feedback from our community to ensure your IRL meetups are safe and comfortable.

quotes.text:
The idea for TwoTickets started when my wife and I had two tickets to Hamilton, and she couldn’t make it at the last minute. I realized how awkward it is to want to go to a concert, game, or show but not have someone to share it with — and how current apps either constrain you to your circle or to endless swiping.

On TwoTickets, you Twoot an event in order to connect with others around that shared plan. The flow is simple: Twoot → Match → Chat → Decide → Go. You don’t see profiles or matches until you Twoot events, so plans come first and profiles second.

The aim is to make meeting new people more natural: the event itself is the ice-breaker, not a random line in a bio. We’re in soft launch now and would love feedback from HN — does this “event-first” approach resonate with you, and where do you see the pitfalls?

Paul Graham once said that all dating apps are really just matching apps. I wonder: how close is this to a solution to that assertion — although TwoTickets is broader than dating.

*Links:*  
- Website: https://www.twotickets.us  
- iOS App: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/twotickets-match-eventfully/id1596912801
